name: claudechip
description: Connects Claude Code to the Claude Chip desk device: session status, short summaries and approve/deny keys.

account.title: Account name
account.description: Shown on the device, e.g. SQUEEZE (personal) or EGLUU (work). Macs with the same name are grouped.

mac_name.title: This Mac's name
mac_name.description: Shown under the account in the device's selector. Empty: the computer name.

color.title: Account color
color.description: Hex color for the account's tabs and name, e.g. #D7DF23.

summary.title: Summaries
summary.description: deck_line: Claude ends each answer with a [DECK] line for the device. truncate: first sentence of the answer.

usage_source.title: Plan usage (SES / SEM)
usage_source.description: auto: read it from Anthropic with your Claude Code login (macOS asks once for Keychain access). statusline: only what terminal sessions report.

open_in.title: Open sessions in
open_in.description: Where a session resumed from the device opens. auto: iTerm2 if installed, else Terminal. phpstorm: opens the project and copies the resume command to the clipboard.

away_after.title: Questions to the device after (s)
away_after.description: Claude's multiple-choice questions go to the device when nobody has touched this Mac for this many seconds; otherwise they show in the terminal.
